headline: Recent launches, new SKUs to drive numbers

highlights: As per IQVIA MAT September 2026, Acute: Chronic ratio was 73:27 Result Performance & Investment Rationale: • Q 2FY2 7 – S teady revenue growth and flat margins : Revenues grew ~13% to ~Rs 726 crore, driven by growth in power brands such as Eliquis (CVS), Gelusil-MPS(Gastrointestinal) and Magnex (Anti-infective) among others.
There was a de-growth in other power brands such as Becosules (VMS), Mucaine (Antacid), Zavicefta (anti-infective), Meronem (anti- infective).
EBITDA grew ~14% with a margin increased by 14 bps YoY to 35.9% due despite GPM de-growth by 541 bps to 59.1%.
Most of the growth has been through recent launches (over the past 5 years) and the new SKUs.
